fields.summary: Book Store accounts - create a user, get a token, sign in and sign out

content.text: an account I can create through the Book Store API and use to sign in on the web site
I can keep a personal book collection.
, documented in the Swagger UI at
lets a client create a user account, request an access token for it and check whether the account is authorized.
The same account is used to sign in on the web site, where the profile page greets the user by name.
Wrong credentials must be handled cleanly on both the web site and the API, and the password policy must be enforced
Accounts are created through the API (
) with a unique user name per run
The password for these accounts is taken from the environment variable
(it satisfies the password policy below). Never hard-code a password.
Password policy: at least 8 characters, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and

The "New User" registration form on the web site.

This applies to GenerateToken only - AC-8 (Authorized) stays as written.
Reminder: the registration form on the web site is not part of this story, accounts for sign-in are always created through the API.
